entities.name: A0PQ31
observations: Exact sequence match to the 414-aa query; reviewed UniProt protein from Mycobacterium ulcerans.
Annotated as phthiocerol/phthiodiolone dimycocerosyl transferase, EC 2.3.1.282.
Catalyzes diesterification of phthiocerol, phthiodiolone, and phenolphthiocerol with mycocerosic acids in the final PDIM biosynthetic step.
Can transfer mycocerosate directly from the mycocerosic acid synthase (Mas) ACP domain to substrate alcohols; annotated as monomeric.
Reference active-site proton acceptor at position 118; position 122 contributes to active-site organization; position 304 supports Mas ACP recognition.

entities.name: Query enzyme
observations: Length 414 aa; predicted molecular mass 45.39 kDa and pI 4.86.
Contains a PapA_C domain (PF16911.11) at residues 200-385.
Sequence-based identification is supported by 100% identity and 100% coverage to reviewed A0PQ31.

entities.name: PDIM mycocerosyl transfer
observations: EC 2.3.1.282 reaction: mycocerosyl-[mycocerosic acid synthase] plus phthiocerol, phthiodiolone, or phenolphthiocerol yields the corresponding dimycocerosyl ester and holo-mycocerosic acid synthase.
The enzyme performs acyl transfer/diesterification using Mas-bound mycocerosate rather than a freely diffusible acyl-CoA substrate.
